in_sanskrit.name: सरस्बनि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is prosperous like a lake or pond.

in_hindi.long_meaning: One who produces or yields prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Sarbani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarbani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is the embodiment of the grace and beauty of the earth, personified as the goddess Saraswati and Lakshmi.
